nodes.summary: Catalan numbers and generalizations defined by formulas or recurrences: Fuss–Catalan, super Catalan, (p,q)-Patalan, Whitt and Sabar arrays, generalized Catalan–Schröder, Fine and Riordan numbers, Narayana numbers and polynomials, Touchard's identity, Raney's cycle lemma, and divisibility or growth of these numbers.
nodes.title: Catalan numbers and their generalizations

nodes.summary: Statistics on Dyck paths (peaks, valleys, marked steps, subwords) and their variants (skew, rational, k-box Dyck paths), lattice walks with unit or diagonal steps, Delannoy numbers, Sulanke arrays, colored Dyck paths, and nonintersecting paths via the Lindström–Gessel–Viennot lemma.
nodes.title: Dyck paths and lattice walks

nodes.summary: Motzkin numbers and paths: colored, weighted and (u,l,d) Motzkin paths, humps and peaks, the Motzkin triangle, links with central trinomial coefficients, alternating Motzkin sums, Aigner's inequality, and Motzkin-related sequences such as A005773; weighted Motzkin paths used to compute Hankel determinants go to Hankel determinants and continued fractions.
nodes.title: Motzkin numbers and Motzkin paths

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
